description: Microsoft's server failing, for Microsoft Graph accounts: reports Thunderbird's 'responded with an error' notices, holds them back while the add-on says the server is failing, and runs the folder list sync of an account.

functions.name: setQuiet
functions.description: Holds back (true) or shows again (false) Thunderbird's notices for an account.

functions.name: syncFolderList
functions.description: Runs Thunderbird's folder list sync of a Graph account. Returns { ok, reason?, network? }.

functions.name: getNewMail
functions.description: Gets the new mail of a Graph account (folder list and folders). Returns false when it cannot start.

functions.name: indexGraphMail
functions.description: Keeps Thunderbird's message index (Gloda) up to date for Graph accounts: mail the Graph sync adds is indexed, and the Graph folders whose message count changed since the last call (all of them with force) are marked for Gloda's next sweep. Returns the number of folders marked.

functions.name: status
functions.description: Returns { index: { gloda, queued, dirtied, lastCheck }, watching, quiet, seen, held, lastError }.

events.name: onServerError
events.description: Thunderbird showed (or would show) 'Server ... responded with an error.' for a Graph account.
